settings_payment_desc: Automatically notify customers whose app/website booking was left incomplete.
settings_abandoned_reminder_enabled_help: Any app/website booking that is left unpaid (Draft or Failed) gets one message after the wait period.
settings_abandoned_coupon_enabled_help: Choose whether the message includes a personal one-time discount coupon or is just a plain reminder.
settings_abandoned_coupon_percent_error: Discount percent must be a whole number from 1 to 100
settings_abandoned_coupon_delay_help: How long to wait after the customer leaves the booking before sending the message. Example: 30 = sent 30 minutes later. Bookings abandoned more than 24 hours ago are skipped, so customers are not messaged about old bookings.
settings_abandoned_coupon_delay_error: Delay must be a whole number from 1 to 1440 minutes
settings_abandoned_coupon_save_blocked: Fix abandoned booking recovery fields before saving
settings_social_desc: Configure your social media presence across different platforms.
settings_social_tip2: Ensure links are public and accessible
settings_social_tip3: Test links regularly to ensure they're working
settings_social_tip4: Use consistent branding across all platforms
settings_app_desc: Configure download links for your mobile applications.
settings_app_note1: Ensure your app is published and available on the respective stores
settings_app_note2: Test the links regularly to ensure they direct to the correct app
settings_app_note3: Use the official app store URLs for best compatibility
settings_app_note4: Consider using app store optimization (ASO) for better visibility
settings_seo_desc: Manage SEO for each page in Arabic and English.
settings_seo_best3: Use unique titles and descriptions for each page
settings_business_desc: Manage your business contact and registration details.
settings_business_guide1: Ensure all registration numbers are accurate and up-to-date
settings_business_guide2: Keep contact information current for customer inquiries
settings_business_guide3: Verify email addresses are correct and monitored regularly
settings_business_guide4: Update address information if your business location changes
settings_rate_desc: Configure color ranges per metric. Each dashboard rate card uses its own key settings.
settings_terms_desc: Manage your legal terms content in both Arabic and English.
settings_conditions_desc: Manage your privacy policy content in both Arabic and English.
settings_abandoned_reminder_on: Active — messages are being sent to customers with incomplete bookings.
settings_abandoned_reminder_off: Not active — no messages are sent to customers.
settings_abandoned_coupon_on: Coupon included — the message carries a personal discount coupon.
settings_abandoned_coupon_off: No coupon — the message is a plain reminder with no discount.
settings_msg_desc: This is the notification the customer receives. The same text is used whether or not a coupon is attached. Leave it empty to use the system default text.
settings_msg_placeholders: Click to insert into the field you are editing:
settings_msg_preview: Preview as the customer sees it
settings_msg_preview_empty: The system default text will be sent.
settings_msg_preview_note: Sample values are used for the name and code. The real values are filled in per customer.
settings_msg_preview_inactive: The message is not active right now, so nothing is sent until you turn it on.
settings_msg_warn_coupon_off: The coupon is turned off, but this text uses {code} / {percent}. Remove them, or turn the coupon on.
settings_msg_warn_no_code: The coupon is on, but the text does not include {code}. The customer will not see the coupon code.
settings_msg_preview_default_title: The system default title will be sent.
settings_msg_preview_default_body: The system default message will be sent.
settings_ww_desc: A gift amount added to the wallet of every new client when they verify their phone for the first time.
settings_ww_enabled_help: A new client who verifies their phone for the first time gets the amount in their wallet. It can be spent inside the app only, it cannot be withdrawn, and it expires.
settings_ww_on: Active — new clients receive the welcome bonus.
settings_ww_off: Not active — new clients do not receive a bonus.
settings_ww_amount_error: Amount must be a number from 0.01 to 10000
settings_ww_days_help: Counted from the day the bonus is credited. Whatever is unused is removed from the wallet.
settings_ww_days_error: Days must be a whole number from 1 to 365
settings_ww_notif_desc: Each switch turns off only its own notification. Turning them off does not stop the bonus itself.
settings_ww_credit_notif_help: Sent to the client when the gift is added to their wallet.
settings_ww_credit_notif_on: Active — the client is notified when credited.
settings_ww_credit_notif_off: Not active — no notification when credited.
settings_ww_expiry_notif_help: Sent before the gift expires. Applies immediately to bonuses that are already running.
settings_ww_expiry_notif_on: Active — the client is reminded before expiry.
settings_ww_expiry_notif_off: Not active — no reminder before expiry.
settings_ww_hours: Send reminder this many hours before expiry
settings_ww_hours_help: Must be shorter than the bonus lifetime, otherwise no reminder is sent. Example: a 2-day lifetime is 48 hours, so a 72-hour reminder is never sent.
settings_ww_hours_warn: The reminder time is not shorter than the bonus lifetime, so no reminder will be sent. Lower the hours or increase the days.
settings_ww_hours_error: Hours must be a whole number from 1 to 720
settings_ww_texts_desc: All texts are optional. When a field is empty the system default (shown in grey) is used. If only the title or only the message is empty, the default is used for that part alone. The notification is sent in the client's language.
settings_ww_placeholders_title: Placeholders you can type in the text:
settings_ww_ph_name: the client's name (removed if the client has no name)
settings_ww_ph_amount: the amount (in the reminder: what is left of it)
settings_ww_save_blocked: Fix the welcome wallet bonus fields before saving
